stops.name: Allgäu Alps
stops.detail: The old towns of Memmingen and Mindelheim exude medieval flair. Marktoberdorf offers an attractive balance between nature and town life. Sonthofen, on the northern edge of the Allgäu Alps, is the heart and hub of the Upper Allgäu. Füssen, on Lake Forggensee, is overshadowed by Neuschwanstein Castle, the realisation of the medieval dream and spectacular hideaway of Ludwig II. Ottobeuren is famous for its remarkable work of art, the Baroque Benedictine Abbey.
